Title: When will modules in ensure() be loaded to page? 
Description: After reading the docs and examples of Code Split,
I don't really understand it.

``` js
var a = require("a");
var b = require("b");
require.ensure(["c"], function(require) {
    require("b").xyz();
    var d = require("d");
});
```

My question is when will "c" be loaded?
When should I use require.ensure()?
